Verified independently and clean: PR head matches dd97e49; server only accepts GET/HEAD (POST → 405 READ_ONLY); static routes are an exact-match allowlist (traversal probes /../../../etc/passwd and /%2e%2e/server.mjs both 404); safeResolve() correctly rejects ../ and absolute-path escapes; all git/execFileSync calls use shell: false with argv arrays (no shell injection); every dynamic value rendered in app.js goes through the esc() HTML-escaping helper — no XSS gap found; modelUsed/aiSteps/tokens/credits are hardcoded UNKNOWN because nothing in the codebase ever writes those fields — no fabricated agent/cost data; humanGate.approvalStored/shopifyWriteApproved are hardcoded false, nothing in control-center/ writes to disk, calls Shopify, calls any agent/model API, or runs git commit/push/merge; Odense correctly shows NOT_LOADED because none of the fixed PREVIEW_ROOTS/PREVIEW_FILES paths currently exist in the repo; path handling uses path.join/path.sep throughout with no shell/POSIX-only assumptions — no Windows portability issue found.

No changes made, nothing merged, Shopify untouched.
